source: GeoNames Iran dump (download.geonames.org/export/dump/IR.zip, CC-BY 4.0), feature class P, feature code PPL only
note: Village names are GeoNames rows with a Persian-script alternate name, normalized (Arabic letters mapped to Persian). County (shahrestan) attribution is NOT available in this source: admin2 is empty for 99.6% of PPL rows, so villages are grouped by province only, not by city/county. Names matching a pack city in the same province were excluded so cities are not listed as villages. This is a validated subset, not an official complete village register.
